::: proof

For entry $(i,j)$, where row $i$ indexes the denominator $\vb$
and column $j$ indexes the numerator $\matr{A}\vecf{v}$
(see @def-vector-valued-derivative):

$$
\ba
\left[\deriv{\vb} (\matr{A}\vecf{v})\right]_{ij}
&= \deriv{\beta_i} (\matr{A}\vecf{v})_j \\
&= \deriv{\beta_i} \sumto{k}{q} a_{jk} v_k \\
&= \sumto{k}{q} a_{jk} \deriv{\beta_i} v_k \\
&= \sumto{k}{q} \left[\deriv{\vb} \vecf{v}\right]_{ik} \left[\tp{\matr{A}}\right]_{kj} \\
&= \left[\paren{\deriv{\vb} \vecf{v}} \tp{\matr{A}}\right]_{ij}
\ea
$$

:::
